 Xiaomi and POCO are dropping massive 11.11 Mega Sale deals on Shopee and Lazada
 Ready for the 11.11 shopping spree? 🛍️ Xiaomi and POCO are dropping major discounts on phones, tablets, and smart home gear from Nov 6 to 15 on Shopee and Lazada. Here's everything you need to know 👇 #Xiaomi #POCO #1111MegaSale
 by 
 ASTIG PR 
 5 hours ago 5 hours ago 
 Advertisements 
 MANILA, Philippines (Nov 2026) – Tech lovers looking to upgrade their setup can snag big savings as the Xiaomi and POCO 11.11 Mega Sale lands on Shopee and Lazada with major discounts across mobile devices and smart home gear.
 The shopping event runs from Nov. 6 to 15, 2026, offering shoppers nationwide access to price cuts on popular smartphones, tablets, and smart home essentials. Buyers can also look forward to exclusive product bundles, free gifts, and extra discount vouchers throughout the promotional period.
 Catch the biggest drops during Peak Flash Sale
 Pinoys eyeing the deepest price drops will want to mark Nov. 10 and 11 on their calendars. The two-day Peak Flash Sale period promises the largest price markdowns of the entire event across official brand storefronts on both Lazada and Shopee.
 Whether you are looking to replace an old phone, pick up a new tablet for work or school, or outfit your living space with smart appliances, the 11-day event provides multiple opportunities to save.
